name: Name
da_completion_empty: No assessments in this scope yet. Department completion rates will appear once employees begin their self-assessments.
da_ninebox_empty: No 9-box placements available in this scope yet. The by-department distribution will appear after talent calibration.
da_load_error: Unable to load this data right now. Please try again later.
db_intro: Every brief is archived exactly as it was computed and sent. Its figures are never recomputed when you open it.
db_no_briefs: No archived brief matches this filter. The series starts at the first send; nothing is reconstructed afterwards.
db_dept_out_of_scope: That department is outside your scope: the filter was ignored.
db_manage_frequency: Manage the frequency of this brief
db_series_start: Your {{cadence}} brief series started on {{date}}. Comparison becomes available from the second brief onwards.
db_superadmin_note: SuperAdmin view: briefs of every recipient are listed. No name is ever stored inside a brief.
db_forbidden_not_yours: This brief is addressed to somebody else: it is not served to you.
db_forbidden_out_of_scope: This brief covers departments that are outside your scope today.
db_forbidden_recompute: Recomputation is offered to the recipient of the brief only.
db_nothing: Nothing to report for this period.
db_frozen_note: Figures frozen on {{date}} — a later recomputation may differ, the reference data moves.
db_recompute_hint: Recomputing adds a separate column; it never replaces the figures that were sent.
db_recompute_unavailable: Recomputation unavailable: you are not the recipient of this brief.
db_names_withheld: {{n}} person(s) are not named: they are no longer your direct reports today.
db_names_admin: Names are never published for an administration scope: only the counts are shown.
db_without_requirements: of which {{n}} with no requirement defined
db_import_batch: includes an import ({{share}}% of the facts share one minute)
db_cap_hit: sweep cap reached on this department: the count is a lower bound.
db_no_cta: Campaign locked: a statement, with no action.
db_prefs_hint: Choose the cadences you want to receive. The brief stays readable and archived even when no message is sent.
db_prefs_weekly_note: Weekly is off by default for supervisors and managers: the Monday digest already carries the same lines.
db_prefs_unavailable: Your cadence preferences cannot be read right now.
db_partial_period: Partial period — data available since {{date}}: no change figures are published for this period.
db_totals_not_aggregated: Not aggregated: this figure exists per department only and is never re-aggregated (a mean of means). It is not a missing measurement.
